title: 2027 Select Board Meeting Schedule
text: OFFICE OF THE SELECT BOARD SELECT BOARD Carole Julius, Chair Katherine Mullen, Vice-Chair Peter Spagone Jr., Clerk TOWN OF EAST BRIDGEWATER www.eastbridgewaterma.org 175 CENTRAL STREET EAST BRIDGEWATER, MASSACHUSETTS 02333-1912 Telephone: 508-378-1601 Facsimile: 508-378-1636 November 10, 2026 Kathleen Cavanagh, Town Clerk Town Hall East Bridgewater, MA 02333 Dear Kathleen: The Select Board voted unanimously at their November 9, 2026, meeting the following Select Board Meeting Schedule for January – December 2027 at 6:00 pm. Meetings may be added or cancelled, and times are also subject to change.
